_comment: Each of the 19 drawables matches google/material-design-icons at commit 10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7 path for path: symbols/android/<name>/materialsymbolsrounded/<name>_24px.xml or <name>_fill1_24px.xml for ink_eraser, error, fit_screen, ink_highlighter, info, chevron_right, chevron_left, folder_open, ink_pen, redo, download, share, check_circle, touch_app and undo. The repository's LICENSE is Apache-2.0 and it has no NOTICE.
name: Material Symbols (interface icons)
description: The app's 24 dp icons (res/drawable/ic_*.xml except ic_asterisk and ic_launcher_monochrome) are Material Symbols Rounded by Google. Their path data is unchanged; Asterinked changed only the colour attributes (black fill, no theme tint).
